content.short: Fractional enables collective ownership by letting users own fractions of expensive NFTs.
content.description: Fractional is an NFT tooling platform that enables users to own fractions of expensive NFTs, widening access to high-value digital assets. It was launched in July 2021 by Andy Chorlian and began as a simple smart contract for fractional ownership, designed to foster communities around popular NFT projects. In August 2022, the project expanded into a complete NFT infrastructure and rebranded as Tessera, continuing to support fractional ownership at scale and enabling broader participation in coveted NFT markets.
